chapter: Joining and playing with Miles Davis
title: End of day one and opening of day two
summary: Brown confirms he was in Miles's band by November 1968 and the tape ends; day two starts on November 11.

blocks.x: We’re going to run out of tape here quickly but I just wanted to ask. So when you did the recording with Miles in November of 68’ were you officially a member of the band at that point?
Because as we continue when we resume, you end up going on tour in Europe with him in the beginning of 69’… HOUR 4
